description: 2022苗栗縣政府公共區域無線網路服務效益總表 [telecommunications] (series on Taiwan Government Open Data Platform) is a series of datasets listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 數位研考處. 苗栗縣政府公共區域無線網路服務效益總表. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal lists 7 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 數位研考處. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-06-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
